detail.longDescription: 🐦 NEW: Biologists measured call amplitude in 123 bird species across # Massachusetts and # Brazil using # golf rangefinders paired with # sound meters, adding first-time # data for 113 of them. Volumes spanned 58 dB, from # hummingbirds near conversational levels to the bare-throated # bellbird and red-legged # seriema above 120 dB. The louder # species tend to be larger with wider beaks. 👉 https://www. popsci.com/environment/worlds- loudest-birds/ # birds # biology # ornithology # birdsong # bioacoustics # decibels # evolution # fieldwork # research # science # education # nature # wildlife # animals
